fields.label: Total in Store (Bin)
fields.description: Raw stock qty in the Bin, before excluding what other running Jobs have already claimed

fields.label: Reserved by Other Running Jobs
fields.description: Sum of this material on submitted Indents for OTHER Jobs that are not yet Closed/Cancelled

fields.label: Available for THIS Job
fields.description: total_bin_qty minus reserved_other_jobs — what's genuinely free for this Job

fields.label: Excess Stock after Requirement
fields.description: Stock still free after this Job's requirement is covered; it remains available for upcoming Jobs.

fields.label: Qty to Procure
fields.description: Required Qty minus Available for THIS Job. Only this balance is sent to PO Initiation.

fields.label: Rate (est.)
fields.description: Entered manually — not pulled from a price list. Used only to estimate indent value for the Job profitability check.
